configuration.candidate_selection: equal-weight RRF of existing BM25 top 50 and dense top 50; take fused top 50
configuration.tie_break: descending reranker logit, then ascending stable chunk ID
configuration.timing: one full 50-candidate scoring pass per development question; tokenize+inference+sort; model loading and retrieval excluded
configuration.selection_policy: One model/configuration for this stage, fixed before scoring; report regressions without trying alternatives.
configuration.pool_policy: Retain old judgments; judge every new top-10 passage before comparing all four methods on one expanded pool.
configuration.heldout_policy: Do not execute heldout-v1 during development or use it to tune this configuration. Later final run must record this freeze hash.

embedding_query_prefix: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:
corpus_policy: Reuse the original document vectors and chunks; encode only the 16 new queries.
warmup_policy: Use the first development question for embedding and eight reranker pairs; no heldout warmup.
timing_policy: One timed retrieval/rerank pass per heldout question; model loading and initial warmup excluded.
review_policy: Pool all four top-10 rankings; explicit AI grades with source excerpts before scoring. No unjudged-as-zero.
metrics_policy: Same graded nDCG, MRR, direct MRR, P@10 and pooled recall as development; macro-average answerable questions only.
selection_policy: Report all four fixed methods, including regressions; no model, threshold, prompt, depth or weight tuning on these results.
